title: Novel Properties of Generalized Core-EP Inverses in Banach Algebras
content: In this paper, we characterize the generalized core-EP invertibility of the sum of two Banach elements, and directly address the existence of their generalized core-EP inverse. Unlike existing results on additive properties of core-EP inverses, our results establish such properties for generalized core-EP inverses for the first time, thereby extending the theory to a broader class of elements, including Banach algebra elements and Hilbert space operators. This generalization unifies and extends several known results on core-EP inverses. Illustrative examples are also provided to demonstrate the validity of our main results.
